title: Deep Drilling
description: The deepest hole ever drilled went down 12 km and met rock at 180 °C, softer than expected and full of water. Drilling deep is a fight with heat and pressure. Unlocks the Deep Drilling Rig.

puzzle.goal: Heat flows up out of the planet at q watts per square metre through rock that conducts k watts per metre per kelvin. The surface is at T _ 0. Write the temperature T a depth h down.
puzzle.name: Geothermal gradient
puzzle.ask: Find T in kelvin at the bottom of the deepest hole, h = 12000 m, with A = @{A} K, q = @{q} W/m² and k = @{k} W/(m·K).
puzzle.method: Fourier's law: the heat flow is the conductivity times how fast the temperature rises with depth.
